Always write docs/runbook.md when endpoints change.
Never use bare except in scheduler code.
Always run p95 benchmarks before and after each stage.
Never deploy the cron unit without a rollback one-liner.
Always keep migrations reversible for two releases.
Never run the live deploy before the dry-run passes.
Always include a breadcrumbs comment at cut points.
Always set the timezone flag on scheduler jobs.
Always append a changelog entry per release.
